This application coming on for admission this day, the 
 following:
 Order

This is Ist bail application under Section 439 of Cr.P.C for grant of regular bail in connection with crime No.126/2023 dated : not mentioned registered at P.S. - Bagli, District - Dewas for offences punishable under Sections 363, 366A, 376, 376(2)(n) of IPC and Section 5L, 6 of POCSO Act.
2. The prosecution case is that father of the prosecutrix lodged a missing report of her daughter.
She was recovered by the police and registered a criminal case for the aforesaid offences.
3. Counsel for the applicant submits that in the statement under Section 164 of Cr.P.C. the prosecutrix has not alleged any allegation of physical exploitation by the present applicant.

sentences.text: 4. Counsel for the State opposes the prayer and submits that as per the date of birth recorded in the scholar register, the prosecutrix was 17 years & 14 days on the date of incident and, therefore, the application is liable to be rejected.

5. After hearing learned counsel for the parties and considering the statement of the prosecutrix that she has not alleged any allegation of physical relationship or exploitation by the present applicant,
he is in jail since 11.08.2023, the investigation has been completed, the charge-sheet has been filed,
no further custodial interrogation is required and the trial may take time, I am of the view that the applicant is entitled for grant of bail.
Without commenting on the merits of the case, the application is allowed.

6. It is directed that applicant Rajendra shall be released from custody upon furnishing a personal bond of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with one surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the Ld. Court below.
7. A typed copy of this order is being forwarded to the Office of the Advocate General, on their email address, for intimation to the Police Station concerned.
The office is requested to forward a copy of this order to the Ld. Court below.
8. With the aforesaid, the application is allowed and disposed off.

(VIJAY KUMAR SHUKLA) JUDGE soumya Rajendra vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 16 January, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/193866329/
